changeSet.sql:
update r set r.AssetTypeId = ISNULL(at.ID, AT2.Id) from report r left join AssetType AT on AT.Object = R.ObjectType AND at.ObjectID = r.ObjectID left join AssetType AT2 on AT2.Object = (R.ObjectType+'Type') AND AT2.ObjectID = r.ObjectID WHERE at.id is not null or AT2.Id is not null
update r set r.Location = Location.Value from report r outer apply ( select case when ShowOnHomePage = 1 then 3 when IsType.Value = 0 then 2 else 1 end as Value from Report rep outer apply (Select count(1) as Value from Report where id = r.ID and rep.ObjectType like '%Type')IsType where rep.ID = r.ID )Location
update dbo.report set ReportType = 1 where ReportType = 'powerbi' update dbo.report set ReportType = 2 where ReportType = 'sagacity' update dbo.report set ReportType = 3 where ReportType = 'legacy'
update r set r.Definition = JSON.val from dbo.Report r outer apply (select PowerBIReportID as powerBiReportId, PowerBIDatasetID as powerBiDatasetId, [FileName] as fileName, [url] as url from dbo.Report where id = r.ID FOR JSON AUTO, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)JSON(val)
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'ObjectType') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Report DROP COLUMN ObjectType END
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'ObjectID') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Report DROP COLUMN ObjectID END
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'PowerBIReportID') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Report DROP COLUMN PowerBIReportID END
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'PowerBIDatasetID') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Report DROP COLUMN PowerBIDatasetID END
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'FileName') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Report DROP COLUMN FileName END
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'Url') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Report DROP COLUMN Url END
IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'ShowOnHomePage') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Report] DROP CONSTRAINT DF_Report_ShowOnHomePage; ALTER TABLE dbo.Report DROP COLUMN ShowOnHomePage END

changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'analytics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Statistic') BEGIN declare @newTableCount int = 0; select @newTableCount = count(1) from usage.Analytic; if @newTableCount = 0 begin insert into usage.Analytic ([UserId], [Timestamp], [IpId], [Browser], [Language], [Locale], [Action], [AssetId], [AssetTypeId], [DashboardId]) select S.ResourceID, S.Timestamp, S.IpID, case when ua.Value like '%edge%' then 2 when ua.Value like '%firefox%' then 3 when ua.Value like '%trident%' then 8 when ua.Value like '%opr%' then 4 when ua.Value like '%safari%' and ua.Value not like '%chrome%' then 5 when ua.Value like '%chrome%' then 1 else 9 end as DeterminedBrowser, substring(bl.Value,1,2) as [Language], iif(bl.Value like '%en-US;%', 'en-US', substring(bl.Value,1,5)) as [Locale], 1 as [Action], coalesce(O_A.Id, O_AC.ID) as AssetId, coalesce(O_AT.ID, O_ACT.AssetTypeID) as assetTypeId, O_R.Id as DashboardId from analytics.Statistic S inner join analytics.[Object] O on O.ID = S.Object left join AssetType O_AT on O_AT.Object = O.Value and O_AT.ObjectID = S.ObjectID left join Asset O_A on O_A.Object = O.Value and O_A.ObjectID = S.ObjectID left join AssetWithType O_AC on O_AC.AssetTypeClass = try_cast(O.Value as int) and O_AC.ObjectID = S.ObjectID left join AssetWithType O_ACT on O_ACT.AssetTypeClass = try_cast(O.Value as int) and O_ACT.TypeID = S.ObjectID left join Report O_R on O.Value = 'Report' and O_R.ID = S.ObjectID inner join analytics.BrowserLanguage bl on bl.ID = S.BrowserLanguageID inner join analytics.UserAgent ua on ua.ID = S.UserAgentID where coalesce(O_A.Id, O_AC.ID) is not null or coalesce(O_AT.ID, O_ACT.AssetTypeID) is not null or O_R.Id is not null end END

changeSet.sql:
drop table if exists #temp_values select FTL.FieldTypeID, D.FieldTypeId as FilterFieldId, D.Filter, D.RelationIndex into #temp_values from FieldTypeLookup FTL cross apply ( select case when DF.FieldTypeId > 1 then cast(DF.FieldTypeId as nvarchar(255)) else DF.FieldTypeName end as FieldTypeId, DF.FieldTypeName, DF.[Filter], DF.OverrideDisplayName, DF.DisplayOrder, DF.SortOrder, DF.SortByAscending, DF.Show, DF.Width, DF.RelationIndex from OPENJSON(FTL.Definition) with (Fields nvarchar(max) as json)D outer apply OPENJSON(D.Fields) with (AssetTypeUid uniqueidentifier, FieldTypeID int, FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), [Filter] nvarchar(500), OverrideDisplayName nvarchar(250), DisplayOrder int, SortOrder int, SortByAscending bit, Show bit, Width int, RelationIndex int) DF )D WHERE ISJSON(FTL.Definition) = 1 and D.[Filter] is not null and LTRIM(RTRIM(D.[Filter])) <> ''
drop table if exists #expressions select FieldTypeID, '(H' + CAST((RelationIndex + 1) as nvarchar(255)) + '_' + CAST(FilterFieldId as nvarchar(255))+ +' ct ''' + Filter+ ''')' as FilterExpression into #expressions from #temp_values
select * from #expressions
drop table if exists #fullExpressions
select FieldTypeID, concat('(',STRING_AGG(FilterExpression, ' and ' ),')') AS expression into #fullExpressions from #expressions group by FieldTypeID
UPDATE T SET T.Definition = JSON_MODIFY(T.Definition, '$.Filters', FE.expression) from FieldTypeLookup T inner join #fullExpressions fe on fe.fieldTypeId = T.FieldTypeID
